title: DM21: a neural network as a density-functional theory functional
summary: A neural network represents the functional used in DFT and addresses two longstanding errors of traditional functionals: excessive electron delocalization and spin-symmetry breaking during bond breaking. Published in Science with open code; the post gives no benchmark figures and DFT remains an approximation.
ai_technology: DM21 (neural network for the exchange-correlation functional)

evidence.tested: DM21 is compared with traditional functionals on benchmarks for main-group atoms and molecules and on bond-breaking and charge-localisation examples.
evidence.unknown: The page gives no numerical benchmark figures and says DFT remains an approximation.
evidence.ai_role: Neural network represents the exchange-correlation functional in density functional theory.
